001package io.github.ai4ci.output;
002
003import java.util.stream.Stream;
004
005import org.immutables.value.Value;
006
007import io.github.ai4ci.abm.Outbreak;
008import io.github.ai4ci.abm.Person;
009import io.github.ai4ci.flow.output.DuckDBWriter;
010import io.github.ai4ci.flow.output.Export;
011import io.github.ai4ci.flow.output.Export.Stage;
012
013/**
014 * Represents a line list CSV record for epidemic simulation output. This
015 * interface defines the structure of individual-level data exported from an
016 * outbreak simulation, including person identifiers, health status, behavioural
017 * metrics, and epidemiological parameters.
018 *
019 * <p>
020 * Records are exported during the UPDATE stage and are written per agent to a
021 * DuckDB database ({@code linelist.duckdb}).
022 *
023 * <p>
024 * Downstream uses: case line lists are typically consumed by analysis
025 * notebooks, case investigation pipelines and for validation of individual
026 * level dynamics against expected epidemic behaviour.
027 *
028 * @author Rob Challen
029 */
030@Value.Immutable
031@Export(
032                stage = Stage.UPDATE,
033                value = "linelist.duckdb",
034                size = 64 * 64,
035                selector = LineListDuckDB.Selector.class,
036                writer = DuckDBWriter.class
037)
038public interface LineListDuckDB extends CommonCSV.Individual {
039
040        /**
041         * Selector class that implements Export.Selector to provide a stream of
042         * LineListCSV records from an Outbreak simulation for database export.
043         */
044        static class Selector implements Export.Selector {
045                @Override
046                public Stream<LineListDuckDB> apply(Outbreak o) {
047                        return o.getPeople()
048                                .stream()
049                                .map(Person::getCurrentState)
050                                .map(CSVMapper.INSTANCE::toCSV);
051                }
052        }
053
054        /**
055         * Adjusted probability that the person uses a contact tracing app.
056         *
057         * @return the app use probability after adjustments, range 0–1
058         */
059        double getAdjustedAppUseProbability();
060
061        /**
062         * Adjusted compliance metric for the person.
063         *
064         * @return the compliance level after adjustments used in intervention models
065         */
066        double getAdjustedCompliance();
067
068        /**
069         * Adjusted mobility factor after applying policies and individual behaviour.
070         *
071         * @return the mobility adjustment scalar applied to the person's baseline
072         *         mobility (values typically in the range 0–1)
073         */
074        double getAdjustedMobility();
075
076        /**
077         * Adjusted transmissibility for the person after modifiers.
078         *
079         * @return the transmissibility scaling applied to the person based on
080         *         behaviour and other modifiers
081         */
082        double getAdjustedTransmissibility();
083
084        /**
085         * Behavioural label for the person at the time of export.
086         *
087         * @return a short string naming the active behaviour model or behaviour
088         *         class assigned to this person
089         */
090        String getBehaviour();
091
092        /**
093         * Count of contacts recorded for the person at this time step.
094         *
095         * @return the number of contacts observed or simulated for the person
096         */
097        long getContactCount();
098
099        /**
100         * Contact exposure measure for the person.
101         *
102         * @return exposure as a scalar indicating recent contact‑related exposure
103         *         risk for the person
104         */
105        double getContactExposure();
106
107        /**
108         * Count of exposures recorded for the person at this time step.
109         *
110         * @return the number of exposure events attributed to the person
111         */
112        long getExposureCount();
113
114        /**
115         * Log odds of being infectious today, useful for multiplicative models.
116         *
117         * @return the log odds corresponding to
118         *         {@link #getProbabilityInfectiousToday()}
119         */
120        double getLogOddsInfectiousToday();
121
122        /**
123         * Presumed local prevalence as estimated by the agent.
124         *
125         * @return the agent's estimate of local prevalence used to inform behaviour
126         *         models and local risk perception
127         */
128        double getPresumedLocalPrevalence();
129
130        /**
131         * Probability the person is infectious today as computed by the risk model.
132         *
133         * @return probability value in the range 0–1 representing the risk model's
134         *         assessment of infectiousness for the given person and time
135         */
136        double getProbabilityInfectiousToday();
137
138        /**
139         * True local prevalence measured by the model at the person's location.
140         *
141         * @return the ground truth local prevalence computed by the simulation
142         */
143        double getTrueLocalPrevalence();
144
145        /**
146         * Whether the person has died by this time step.
147         *
148         * @return true if the person is recorded as deceased in the current state
149         */
150        boolean isDead();
151
152        /**
153         * Whether this record marks an incident hospitalisation event.
154         *
155         * @return true if this is the first time the person is recorded as requiring
156         *         hospitalisation
157         */
158        boolean isIncidentHospitalisation();
159
160        /**
161         * Whether this record marks an incident infection event.
162         *
163         * @return true if this is the first time the person is recorded as infected
164         */
165        boolean isIncidentInfection();
166
167        /**
168         * Whether the person is considered infectious at this time step.
169         *
170         * @return true if the person's state implies infectiousness at the exported
171         *         time step, false otherwise
172         */
173        boolean isInfectious();
174
175        /**
176         * Whether the person requires hospitalisation at this time step.
177         *
178         * @return true if the person's clinical state indicates hospital admission
179         *         is required at the time of export
180         */
181        boolean isRequiringHospitalisation();
182
183        /**
184         * Whether the person is symptomatic at this time step.
185         *
186         * @return true if symptoms are present for the person at the exported time
187         *         step; used for symptomatic surveillance and case counting
188         */
189        boolean isSymptomatic();
190
